title: Grand Challenges in Healthcare AI

reader_summary.headline: The beauty of technology is that it can unlock not just incremental improvement.
reader_summary.overview: The beauty of technology is that it can unlock not just incremental improvement, but completely change the world we live in today. Just think, 100 years ago, we didn't have the internet, commercial flight, or anything that resolved self-driving cars. But equally in healthcare, 100 years ago, we were still decades away from the double helix discovery, antibiotics, IVF, and so much more.

key_points.text: And perhaps there's no better industry where we can make these truly monumental shifts than in health care.
key_points.evidence_quote: And perhaps there's no better industry where we can make these truly monumental shifts than in health care.

key_points.text: And in today's episode, we explore these audacious grand challenges over the next 100 years, or hopefully even less, in health care AI.
key_points.evidence_quote: And in today's episode, we explore these audacious grand challenges over the next 100 years, or hopefully even less, in health care AI.

key_points.text: The immediate part is something that is so good, like not 10% better than what you have now.
key_points.evidence_quote: The immediate part is something that is so good, like not 10% better than what you have now, but like 10x better than what you have now, that the adoption becomes natural.

key_points.text: A million clinical trials are just organically running in my population every day, and I have no idea how to harness it.
key_points.evidence_quote: A million clinical trials are just organically running in my population every day, and I have no idea how to harness it.

thesis: The speakers argue that healthcare is poised for monumental shifts driven by AI, with the immediate opportunity lying in solutions that are either 10x better than current capabilities or significantly easier to adopt to overcome labor shortages and clinician burnout. They identify administrative back-office tasks, specifically revenue cycle management and claims processing, as the current 'low hanging fruit' where AI can transform a staffing problem into a data problem to reduce costs.
